name: context7
description: Fetch up-to-date, version-pinned documentation and code examples for any library via the Context7 MCP server — resolve library IDs, then pull the exact docs you need without guessing APIs.

interface.shortDescription: Look up live, version-pinned docs for any library.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can look up the latest documentation and code examples for any library or framework — React, Next.js, Zod, Stripe, Tailwind, and thousands more. Instead of relying on outdated training data, your agent fetches the exact docs for the version you're using, so you get accurate, up-to-date answers about APIs, parameters, and usage patterns. No more guessing if an API has changed since your agent was trained.
defaultPrompt: Look up the latest API docs for the library I'm using.
Find me a code example for this specific use case in the docs.
Check if this API has changed in the latest version of the package.
